test_break_on_failure_env_var: test the GTEST_BREAK_ON_FAILURE environment variable to trigger seg-faults on assertion failures
test_break_on_failure_flag: test the --gtest_break_on_failure command line flag to turn assertion failures into segmentation faults
test_flag_overrides_env_var: test that the --gtest_break_on_failure flag overrides the GTEST_BREAK_ON_FAILURE environment variable
test_break_overrides_throw: test that gtest_break_on_failure overrides gtest_throw_on_failure environment variable
run_subprocess_check_signal: run a subprocess command and check if it was terminated by a signal
